IncidentBot: PAGER -> service=api-serving | alert=API_5xx_ratio_us-west-2 | triggered=2026-11-03T15:12:48Z | severity=page | oncall=@Maya R.
Maya R.: ack — joining bridge now. Zoom: https://zoom.company/abc123 :telephone_receiver:
Maya R.: quick summary from metrics: 5xx ratio jumped from 0.6% to 6.2% around 15:10 UTC, p95 latency up ~120ms.
Jordan L.: logging in. seeing a burst of kv-cache evictions and stalled worker queues on gpunode-7. Correlated with an autoscale event and a recent config rollout for batching-opt.
Alex (SRE): I'm pulling recent deploys — confirm there was a config flip 15:05 UTC to enable experimental batching optimizer on canary pool.
Maya R.: mitigation plan -> revert batching-opt on canary, drain requests from gpunode-7, bump concurrency throttle. I'll run revert now.
Maya R.: reverted canary flag (rolling restart) -> observing error rate falling to ~1.8% in last 90s. continuing to monitor. :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: NOTIFICATION -> customer-impact-check requested. Support runbook triggered.
Erin (Support): filing customer-impact tickets for customers with >1% 5xx uplift: cust-42, cust-87, cust-internal. Will attach sample request ids and timeframe.
Priya S.: thanks Erin. can we get a quick estimate of affected requests and window?
Jordan L.: rough numbers: ~12k failed requests over 20m window, spike concentrated 15:08-15:18 UTC. Top endpoints: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream.
Maya R.: current status: error rate trending down to baseline after revert, autoscaler stabilized, no evictions in last 5m. moving to post-incident steps.
Maya R.: immediate followups I want captured in this thread so we can hand off: 1) postmortem meeting + timeline, 2) alert tuning + SLO review, 3) runbook updates, 4) customer comms sync.
Priya S.: I'll own postmortem scheduling. propose Tue 2026-11-09 17:00 UTC (Fri US morning). will send calendar and invite owners.
Jordan L.: Observations for postmortem: the alert was noisy because it aggregated across all clients. we fired a page for a global 4% threshold even though impact was concentrated to a few tenants and a canary. Proposals: - split alert to per-cluster or per-tenant 5xx ratio, - add a short cooldown dedupe window to avoid pages for transient bursts, - convert global aggregated >4% into a warning only.
Maya R.: agree. Also think we should add quick-runbook steps to check "batching-opt" safe state and a tested revert play (currently manual).
Alex (SRE): action suggestions (prometheus syntax example to create group-level rule):
```
# new rule: tenant-scoped 5xx ratio
- alert: Tenant_API_5xx_ratio_high
  expr: (sum by (tenant)(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-serving",code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (tenant)(rate(http_requests_total{job="api-serving"}[5m]))) > 0.05
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```

Jordan L.: Also recommend we don't page on a 5m rolling >4% for the whole region. Instead page on either: 1) tenant-scoped >5% for 2m OR 2) global >10% for 1m. That way small noisy canaries don't wake everyone.
Maya R.: I want a concrete actionlist captured here with owners/due dates — will paste and tag owners.
Maya R.: ACTION ITEMS:
- A1 (Jordan L.) — Create tenant-scoped 5xx alert + cooldown dedupe rule. Due: 2026-11-06.
- A2 (Alex) — Add a documented revert play for batching-opt and add a single-command toggle in ops-console. Due: 2026-11-05.
- A3 (Priya S.) — Schedule and run postmortem, invite eng, oncall, product, and support. Due: 2026-11-09 (meeting).
- A4 (Erin (Support)) — Customer impact tickets + recommended comms draft. Due: 2026-11-04.
- A5 (Maya R.) — Update runbook section: "Investigate 5xx spike -> check batching-opt, kv-cache, autoscaler, node evictions". Due: 2026-11-05.
- A6 (Jordan L. & Alex) — Add monitoring dashboard with tenant heatmap and quick links to drain nodes. Due: 2026-11-07.

Priya S.: acked all, will track in the incident tracker and add owners.
Erin (Support): I'll prepare a short customer-facing postmortem blurb we can use after the internal postmortem is complete.
Jordan L.: small followup on alert noise: also add an annotation to the alert for the triggering config flag so we can immediately correlate pages to recent toggles/deploys. e.g., `config.batch_opt=true` as an output label.
Maya R.: thank you team. final notes: no data exfiltration, no PII affected, customer latency/availability hit limited to the listed window. Marking incident as contained. Moving to post-incident channel items.
IncidentBot: POST-INCIDENT -> created ticket INC-2167002468 in tracker, assigned to Priya S. for postmortem coordination.
Alex (SRE): I'll open a short RFC for the alerting change so we have review before rollout.
Priya S.: closing handoff. If anyone has additional evidence (logs/traces), drop them in the postmortem doc: https://docs.company/postmortems/INC-2167002468.
Maya R.: thanks everyone — great coordination. :heart:
